warning: Reference supported is a package label, not proof of runtime integration. Existing workflows share routes and dialogs; complete screen parity is not claimed.

designDirection.style: Instagram-like density, hairline separators, simple line icons, circular identity; Makan brand
designDirection.mobile: Single-pane stack; bottom tabs; full-route create/edit; primary action visible near thumb; safe area.
designDirection.tablet: Right compact rail, master-detail where useful; forms centered at max 600–640 px.
designDirection.desktop: Right nav, central reading/form column, left contextual panel; independent scroll panes in Messenger.
designDirection.forms: One task per page; required labels and helper text; error adjacent to field; preserve unsaved draft; sticky save.
designDirection.accessibility: 48 px minimum hit areas, readable 16 px body, 4.5:1 body contrast, visible focus, labels and non-color status.
